description: List a folder in your workspace. Returns JSON: items with name, type (file, dir, link), size, mtime; folders add counter_children and aos (aos files inside such as _entry, _tooldef.json, loop.json: then it is a tool or agent); .json files add keys. Folders first; names starting with . are hidden unless hidden is true. At most max_items per call; next_offset means more, call again with offset. Then use stat, view or read on one item. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, FileBad.

path.description: the folder, relative to your workspace (default .)

max_items.description: most items to show (default 100, at most 500)

hidden.description: true = also list names starting with .
